title: Last Water

objectives.text: Land at Last Water's spaceport (Kessar III)
Fight your way into the city (the gate is {gate_dir})
comms: [OVERWATCH] Spaceport's lost. The city's through that gate. The governors were last seen at the Civic Hall.

objectives.text: Find the Brood Lieutenant and take the Civic Hall access card
comms: [OVERWATCH] The Civic Hall's sealed and the governors' card is gone. Militia chatter says one of the big bugs took it. Find it.
[OVERWATCH] Check the militia's logs. They were tracking it.
[OVERWATCH] You've got the card. The Civic Hall is {hall_dir} of the spaceport road.

objectives.text: Free the captive governors (cut their cocoons open)
comms: [OVERWATCH] Life signs inside. Three of them. They're alive, Operative. Get them out of that resin.

objectives.text: Return to the ship (Recall, or the spaceport shuttle)
comms: [GOVERNOR CALLOWAY] OVERWATCH, this is Ada Calloway. The swarm didn't start here. It came from Kessar IV, next door.
[GOVERNOR CALLOWAY] There's a mining claim on Kessar IV. It went quiet a week before we did. Whatever's laying those eggs, it's there.
[OVERWATCH] Understood, Governor. Operative, return to the Mule. You're going to Kessar IV.

debrief: [OVERWATCH] Last Water's governors are safe and the city's militia is regrouping. The treasury sent their thanks in creds.
[OVERWATCH] Kessar IV is on your star map. Find the nest. Kill whatever's in charge.
